evidence: Complete real source archives; no synthetic fixtures or language models

checks.equivalenceCoverage: All totals, exclusions, duplicates, direction ordering, shares, scores, facets, niche candidates, statuses, gaps and source evidence

transport.measurement: Uncompressed file bytes and data request counts only; excludes application assets and HTTP headers. This is not a network latency measurement.

refreshOrSlowBootstrap.note: A differing remote manifest or a slow web bootstrap can add one verified summary transfer; deployment races can require one bounded retry. The two-request case is the healthy same-generation path, observed separately in the local browser report.
